resolution.note: krn lane run --task ID: worktree, headless session, ship, one verdict line; tested on a verbatim result capture

title: One task runs from its record in one call
body:
Outcome: `krn lane run --task <id>` starts the worktree, runs one headless session whose brief is the task body, ships through `krn pr ship`, and prints one verdict line.
Why: C3's replays cost $0.23 a task from a written record.
Proof: a test drives the verb against a verbatim capture of a headless session's JSON result (KRN-12) and sees the verdict line for success, no commit, and a dirty tree.
Scope: `src/cli/lane.ts`, a new `src/cli/lane-run.ts`, `test/cli`. About 1 point.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-program-v2/06-program.md section 2, slice S1.
Operator order 2026-11-10: "Odpalaj" (program v2 planned on Fable).
